fields.summary_ko.0: Dell (NYSE:DELL) share price fell 9.5% following Intel's warning of weak PC demand, with global PC shipments projected to decline 12% in 2026 and an additional 10% decline in 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell's Q3 PC shipments plummeted 25%, exposing vulnerability to market cycle downturns, with current share price of $415.47 down 29.4% from the 52-week high of $588.40.
fields.summary_ko.2: The company announced expansion of its AI security portfolio three days ago, which led to an 8.3% gain, though the stock is up 225% from early this year.
